title: Relationship Policy Configuration
description: Configuration for work item relationship validation policies with timing and state constraints

dateSourceType.description: Source of date value: explicit field or derived from Area Path timeframe

fieldConstraint.description: Constraint on a work item field

value.description: Value to compare against (type depends on operator)

dateComparison.description: Comparison between dates of source and target work items

sourceDate.description: Date source from the source work item

targetDate.description: Date source from the target work item

toleranceDays.description: Tolerance in days for the comparison

dateRequirement.description: Requirements for date existence and temporal constraints

mustExist.description: Date must exist (explicit or derived from timeframe)

mustBeFuture.description: Date must be in the future

mustBePast.description: Date must be in the past

mustBeWithinDays.description: Date must be within N days from today

timeframeAlignment.description: Validation of alignment between explicit dates and Area Path timeframe

allowOverlap.description: Whether overlapping (vs exact match) is sufficient

iterationDateValidation.description: Validation that work item dates fall within the configured sprint/iteration date range

enabled.description: Whether to validate iteration date alignment

validateTargetDate.description: Validate that TargetDate falls within iteration date range

validateStartDate.description: Validate that StartDate falls within iteration date range

allowMissingDates.description: Whether to pass validation if dates are missing (vs treat as violation)

allowMissingIterationDates.description: Whether to pass validation if iteration has no configured dates

useFallbackDates.description: Use dates derived from Area Path timeframe when explicit dates are missing

dateComparison.description: Compare dates between source and target work items (Scenario A)

targetWithinSourceTimeframe.description: Target's date must be within source's timeframe (Scenario B)

requireDate.description: Requirements for date existence and temporal constraints (Scenario C)

validateTimeframeAlignment.description: Validate alignment between explicit dates and Area Path timeframe (Scenario D)

validateIterationDates.description: Validate that work item dates fall within the assigned iteration/sprint date range (Scenario E)

requiredRelationship.description: A required relationship rule with optional timing and state constraints

type.description: Relationship type. Use 'Any' to match any relationship type. For multiple specific types, use 'types' array instead.

types.description: Multiple allowed relationship types (OR logic). When specified, relationships matching ANY of these types will be counted. Takes precedence over 'type' if non-empty. Example: ['Related', 'Parent'] means 'either Related or Parent'.

targetTypes.description: Allowed target work item types. Supports both physical Azure DevOps types and virtual types defined in virtual-types.jsonc

targetStates.description: State constraints on target work items

allTargetsMustMatch.description: Whether all matching targets must satisfy constraints (vs just counting matches)

targetFieldConstraints.description: Field constraints on target work items

workItemType.description: Work item type this policy applies to. Supports both physical Azure DevOps types and virtual types defined in virtual-types.jsonc. Use '*' for all types.

severity.description: Default severity for violations of this policy

stateConstraint.description: State constraints on the source work item (policy only applies if matched)

timingConstraints.description: Timing constraints that apply to the source work item itself

version.description: Configuration schema version (e.g., '1.0'). Used for migration between schema versions.
